name: council
description: A council of independent code reviewers (Codex, Pi, Devin, OpenCodeReview) runs over your working diff in parallel; one summary of agreements, disagreements and unique findings. /council, plus an auto-review that only notifies.

members.title: Members
members.description: Comma list of reviewers to use, in order (codex, pi, devin, ocr). Empty: every installed one.

limitsDir.title: Limits folder
limitsDir.description: Folder of per-member files holding the epoch (seconds) a usage limit resets; a member with a future epoch is skipped. Read only; missing files are ignored.

timeoutMin.title: Member timeout (minutes)
timeoutMin.description: How long one reviewer may run before it is stopped.

summarizer.title: Summarizer
summarizer.description: "claude" (default): the session's Claude merges the findings. "jev": TypeSafe Jev scores duplicates, noise and contradictions (needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY), Claude writes the prose.

summarizerModel.title: Summary model
summarizerModel.description: The Claude model that writes the summary: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or a full model id.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: For the jev summarizer on a remote System One URL; kept in secure storage. Empty: the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable. A loopback URL needs none.

systemOneUrl.title: System One URL
systemOneUrl.description: Base URL of the System One API the jev summarizer asks: TypeSafe by default, or a local server such as Kev (http://127.0.0.1:8010), which needs no key. Plain http is accepted only for 127.0.0.1, localhost and ::1.

systemOneModel.title: System One model
systemOneModel.description: The model System One runs (kev-latest for a local Kev). Empty: TYPESAFE_MODEL, else jev-latest.

jevThreshold.title: Jev noise threshold
jevThreshold.description: Findings Jev rates below this probability of being a real defect move to notes (0 to 1).

autoReview.title: Auto-review
autoReview.description: "off" (default): only /council runs the council. "notify": once the session is idle after an answered turn with a changed diff, the council runs and only notifies you (the members' CLIs may cost you money).

cooldownMin.title: Auto-review cooldown (minutes)
cooldownMin.description: The least time between two auto-reviews.
